title: A self-correction split across two utterances, under the exposure line
description: Dana states an amount, pauses, then in a separate utterance corrects herself with "sorry" and the corrected amount is below the high-value threshold. PROVEN defect (2026-09-14): before the fix, buildExposureEvidence summed BOTH amounts (40,000 + 48,500 = 88,500 > 50k), causing ESCALATE instead of STAGE. FOUNDER RULING (2026-09-14 8:20 PM CDT): a corrected amount does not count toward exposure, whether the correction spans one utterance or multiple. The engine now identifies CORRECTED claims that are NOT additive (no additive-lexicon hit) and excludes their superseded amounts. This fixture proves the split-turn case (shapes C/D2) is handled correctly. The corrected figure still needs an ordinary readback + affirm before it counts as CONFIRMED.
